name: Goi cuon
summary: Gỏi cuốn is a fresh roll of green lettuce and herbs around rice noodles, steamed pork, and a single prawn, with a thick fermented dipping sauce. A second roll uses rice paper, leafy greens, mint, coriander, a protein, and a garlic chive, with hoisin or nước chấm.
origin: An after-school snack in Ho Chi Minh City, and a break at any hour.
culture: Sit on a plastic stool and eat the rolls as a snack, with iced tea after a walk.
texture: The dipping sauce is thick and fermented, and the sauce is the part that makes the difference.
howToEat: Green lettuce and herbs around rice noodles, steamed pork, and one prawn. The thick fermented sauce is the part to notice.
Gỏi cuốn Minh, 84/33 Bùi Viện, District 1, and street vendors around the city.
where: Street vendors around the city, and Gỏi cuốn Minh at 84/33 Bùi Viện.
seoTitle: Gỏi cuốn in Ho Chi Minh City
seoDescription: Fresh rolls in Ho Chi Minh City: lettuce, herbs, noodles, pork, one prawn, and a thick fermented sauce.
